policy.scope: Twelve reviewed issuers including AMD and INTC FY2023-FY2025; AAPL FY2023-FY2025, MSFT FY2023-FY2026, NVDA FY2024-FY2026, and COIN, MSTR, HOOD, XYZ, PYPL, V and TSLA FY2023-FY2025; six reviewed 10-Q quarters each; one prior revenue period supports growth; annual operating, investing and financing cash flow; consolidated USD
policy.selection: Latest filing date on or before as_of, matching exact reviewed dates. Invalid same-date or newer annual or quarterly candidates block selection; conflicting values on any one filing date are ambiguous. A later 10-Q that repeats a quarter as its prior-year comparative is a revision candidate.
policy.as_of: Inclusive filing date, end of day; no intraday point-in-time claim; later API corrections to old records cannot be reconstructed.
policy.revision: Retain earliest eligible value and history; changed values are revision candidates, not proven formal restatements.
policy.net_income: Net income attributable to the issuer (NetIncomeLoss), not income available to common shareholders and not consolidated net income including noncontrolling interests.
policy.cash_flow: Annual net cash provided by (positive) or used in (negative) operating, investing and financing activities; signed USD from standard tags. Standalone quarterly cash flows use current YTD minus preceding-quarter YTD (first quarter uses YTD directly), with both sources retained and mixed-filing basis disclosed. Cash capital expenditures are positive investing cash payments for property, plant and equipment (productive assets for NVDA and V; other productive assets for HOOD); INTC excludes property additions classified as financing cash flows; AMD capex excludes discontinued operations while operating cash flow is consolidated; NVDA includes intangible assets and V includes technology in the filed line; HOOD excludes separately reported capitalized software; exclude acquisitions and noncash leases. Missing standard capex tags remain unavailable, including recent COIN periods. Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus cash capital expenditures, not an issuer-adjusted measure.
policy.growth: Reported annual growth; prior revenue must be positive; consecutive contiguous periods; unequal fiscal period lengths explicitly flagged, not normalized.
policy.basis: Ratios use one accession. Growth may use the latest common filing only when its two values match the latest individually selected values; explain the older comparative basis explicitly.
policy.precision: Exact input decimals and exact rational percentage retained; decimal rendering has 34 significant digits, ROUND_HALF_EVEN; display 2 decimal places.
